_comment: Notes about FIT settings fields that the public FIT profile does not document. Keys are '<mesgNum>.<fieldNum>' or '<mesgNum>'. confidence: documented | inferred | guess | unknown. Inferred entries come from correlating Garmin Connect's settings-change file and device-settings JSON with the watch's Settings.fit. Documented fields (see the FIT profile) are not repeated here.

7.name: zonesTarget
7.note: Heart-rate / power zone configuration; one record per sport group.

8.name: hrZone
8.note: HR zone upper bounds; 6 per zonesTarget group.

147.name: sensorPairing
147.note: 20 slots. Field 2 = device name (e.g. Bluetooth headphones), 50 = 6-byte address, 3/51/52/73 = type/flags.

222.name: alarm
222.note: 20 alarm slots. Field 0 = time in minutes after midnight, 1 = repeat day mask (128 = once), 2 = mode (0 = off), 4 = sound (1 = tone and vibration), 5 = alarm id, 254 = slot.

266.name: unknown266
266.note: Many enum flags, likely feature toggles.

373.name: unknown373
373.note: Field 1 is an 11-element enum array, possibly glance or control order.

379.name: sleepSchedule
379.note: 8 records: field 254 = weekday slot (0..6 Mon..Sun, 7 = default), 0 = bedtime seconds after midnight, 1 = wake time seconds after midnight.

423.name: unknown423
423.note: 20 records with a 32-byte and a 16-byte string.

2.154.name: unknown154
2.154.note: Written per message index 0..2 with values 1,2,3 together with field 157.

3.53.name: unknown53
3.53.note: Value 3; Connect also sent 54 = 4. Possibly intensity-minute HR zones (moderate = 3, vigorous = 4).

2.35.name: unknown35
2.35.note: Connect sent 1; value 1 on this watch. Possibly multiple alarms enabled.

_connectManaged_note: Fields Garmin Connect re-sends on every Garmin Express or phone sync (taken from a real settings-change file). Changes made locally to these fields are overwritten by the next sync unless Connect is updated too.
